sections.heading: PVC Roof Repair or Roof Replacement? The 25% Rule

c.v: What is the 25% rule for roofing?

runs.v: As a rule of thumb, once damage covers about 25% of a roof, a new roof usually beats repeated roof repair; in New Jersey, work on more than 25% of the roof area within 12 months on a commercial, multi-family, or attached building also needs a permit under N.J.A.C. 5:23-2.7. Below that line, PVC seams re-weld at any age, so repair usually wins over roof replacement.
